answer: Each identity must sculpt a marble monument: the beacon emits a fable each epoch, and the agent must carve a lotus signature for every line. The first stanza costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent stanza doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at stanza 14 (20.4 M iterations). A lotus audit verifies each verse against the epoch seed; any skipped stanza voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full tower cost because each line binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
